summary: In 2018, as NM-01's representative, Haaland called the killing of sixty Palestinians in Gaza 'murder,' named each victim, and expressed personal grief during Ramadan. That personal condemnation of Israeli military violence is the sole Israel/Palestine statement in the record, and her 2026 New Mexico campaign platform takes no position on the conflict.
